## Datasheet-dependent checks

- [ ] Exact BeagleBone/processor and safe GPIO voltage confirmed.
- [ ] ADC maximum confirmed before any analogue connection.
- [ ] LED polarity and current-limiting resistor confirmed.
- [ ] Transistor/MOSFET part number, pinout, drive requirement, and load rating confirmed.
- [ ] Relay coil voltage/current and contact ratings confirmed.
- [ ] Flyback diode part, orientation, and rating confirmed.
- [ ] Sensor supply, output type, and logic compatibility confirmed.
- [ ] Capacitor capacitance, voltage rating, polarity, and discharge path confirmed.
- [ ] Lamp, buzzer, or horn voltage/current and supply capacity confirmed.
- [ ] Fuse value and holder rating approved for the conductor and load.

## High-current or inductive load gate

If the project uses a relay, lamp, motor, solenoid, or horn:

- [ ] GPIO drives an approved interface, never the load directly.
- [ ] Relay/transistor/MOSFET circuit has an approved source and return path.
- [ ] Flyback/suppression is installed where required.
- [ ] External load circuit is fused and current-limited where practical.
- [ ] Relay terminal numbers are verified from the actual part, not assumed from shape.
- [ ] Automotive horn use is teacher-controlled and has a quiet alternative.
- [ ] Students know the emergency power-off action.
